lines.text: The psalm opens with Hallelujah and calls for praise to God in His sanctuary and His mighty heavens.
The psalm says to praise Him for His mighty acts and His excellent greatness.
The psalm calls for praise with the sound of the trumpet, and with the harp and lyre.
It calls for praise with tambourine and dancing, strings and flute, and clashing cymbals and resounding cymbals.
The psalm ends by calling every priest to praise the LORD, and then says Hallelujah.
